phrases.text_l2: And I hope to see you soon, my...
Jaljal! Jaljal! Jaljal! Jaljal, look!
Heh! What's this?
I wrote my name with a pencil.
Tan Tan! Tan Tan!
Tan Tan! That's right, very nice.
Your handwriting is excellent, Tan Tan.
What are you doing?
I'm writing a letter to my friend.
Tan Tan, do you need anything?
Do you need help?
No, thanks, Tan Tan.

phrases.text_l1: تن تن، إنت مش بتحبي الكتابة؟
phrases.text_l2: Tan Tan, don't you like writing?
How about you try writing your name
with coloring pens this time?
Ah! Great idea!
I really love coloring pens.
I'll be right back.
Jaljal! Jaljal! Jaljal!
Look how fast I was! I wrote my name
in colors, in orange.
Tan Tan! Tan Tan!
You came back so fast, Tan Tan.

phrases.text_l1: إنت سريعة كتير يا تن تن.
phrases.text_l2: You are very fast, Tan Tan.
Your handwriting is very nice, nice
and the colors are nice too. You're wonderful.
Please,
could you let me finish my letter?
Let me help you.

phrases.text_l1: تن تن، أنا قربت أخلص. بس شوي.
phrases.text_l2: Tan Tan, I'm almost done. Just a bit.
Just leave me for a bit.
My friend...
Tan Tan, I have an idea
that will make you very happy.
What is it?
How about you write your name
with the new alphabet letter blocks?
Ah! Letter blocks! Oh wow!
Excellent idea! I love blocks.
Finally, she's gone.

phrases.text_l1: خليني أكمل بسرعة قبل ما تيجي.
phrases.text_l2: Let me finish quickly before she comes.
The last word:
I will see you soon, my dear friend.
Haha!

phrases.text_l1: أسهل إشي الواحد يكتب اسمه بالمكعبات.
phrases.text_l2: The easiest thing is writing your name with blocks.
Tan Tan! Tan Tan!

phrases.text_l1: عن جد إنت كتبتيهم؟ يا عيني على الألوان!
phrases.text_l2: Did you really write them? Oh, look at the colors!

phrases.text_l1: ألوان كتير حلوة يا تن تن.
phrases.text_l2: Very nice colors, Tan Tan.
Let me see. Oh! Orange colors...
Beautiful, beautiful.
Letters... T N...
Their colors are very nice too.

phrases.text_l1: تن تن! تن تن! تن تن! تن تن!
phrases.text_l2: Tan Tan! Tan Tan! Tan Tan! Tan Tan!

phrases.text_l1: أنا بحب أكتب اسمي يا جلجل.
phrases.text_l2: I love writing my name, Jaljal.
T N, Tan Tan!

phrases.text_l1: تن تن! إيش عم تعملي؟ تن تن!
phrases.text_l2: Tan Tan! What are you doing? Tan Tan!
Tan Tan, you ruined the letter
that I was writing!

phrases.text_l1: تاء نون، تن تن! تاء نون، تن تن!
phrases.text_l2: T N, Tan Tan! T N, Tan Tan!
I love writing my name!
